nāgavana.p: [Nāga+vana] (na) Google Translate (1) A garden called Nagavana. Nagawan Garden Ginkgo Forest Park.
pn: Nāgavana. A pleasance near Hatthigāma, belonging to Uggagahapati. It was there that he first met the Buddha and was converted. AN.iv.213; AN-a.ii.782.
